feature_request: Add password validation to the login system. Require at least 10 characters, one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. Also add tests for valid and invalid passwords.
acceptance_criteria: The system rejects any password with fewer than 10 characters during login.
The system rejects any password that does not contain at least one uppercase letter during login.
The system rejects any password that does not contain at least one number during login.
The system rejects any password that does not contain at least one special character during login.
Unit tests verify that valid passwords pass validation and invalid passwords fail validation for all rules.
